resources.string: Account or device information is missing. Go back and start again.
The unlock request has not been prepared yet. Run the eligibility check first.
The Xiaomi session has no device ID. Sign in again before requesting an unlock.
Network error. Check your connection and try again.
Check the account session, reconnect the phone in fastboot mode, and start the request again.
Sign in again with the account bound to the device. If it still fails, use the official Mi Unlock tool.
The same IP request too often
Xiaomi is rate-limiting this network. Wait before trying again; the app will not retry automatically.
Xiaomi\'s server had an internal error. Try again later. No automatic retry was made.
The request expired before Xiaomi processed it. Go back to the review screen and request a fresh nonce.
The unlock nonce was rejected. Go back to the review screen and request a new one.
Xiaomi no longer accepts this client version. Update the app when a newer version is available.
The device is not activated yet or its activation data is incomplete. Check the account binding and network, then retry after the required waiting period.
This account has reached the device unlock limit. Use an account that meets Xiaomi\'s current limit policy.
You should wait at least 30 days to unlock another device
The server enforces a 30-day window between unlocks. Keep the account bound to the device and wait for that window to pass.
Add your account and device in MIUI\'s Settings > Developer options > Mi Unlock status
Bind the same account on the phone: Settings > Additional settings > Developer options > Mi Unlock status > Add account and device.
Failed to generate signature value required to unlock
Try again later. If the error persists, use the official Mi Unlock tool.
User portrait scores too low or black
Xiaomi\'s account risk/eligibility check failed. The app cannot bypass this; use an account in good standing.
Current account cannot unlock this device
Make sure this account is bound to this exact device. A different account cannot unlock it.
Go to unlock.update.miui.com to download the latest version
Download the current official Mi Unlock version, then retry.
The unlock waiting period has not finished
The waiting period is still active. Keep the account bound to the device and retry after Xiaomi\'s displayed time.
Unlock number has reached the upper limit
The account has reached its unlock limit. Wait for the next quota window.
The device is locked to another Xiaomi account. Sign in with that account, disable Find Device, then retry.
The device token is incomplete. Reconnect the phone in fastboot mode and start again.
You have to use your device for a certain period of time before unlocking it
Use the device normally for the required period before requesting an unlock.
Add a phone number to the Xiaomi account, then try again.
The account region and device region do not match. Use an account from the device\'s region.
Apply for bootloader unlock authorization in Mi Community, then retry.

This Android device cannot act as a USB host, so it cannot communicate with a Xiaomi phone in fastboot mode. You can still read the guide, but unlock and flash features are unavailable on this device.
No USB devices attached. Connect the Xiaomi phone in fastboot mode with an OTG cable, then refresh.
Unlock and flash Xiaomi devices from an Android host.
USB host (OTG) is unavailable on this device.
Server-authorized unlock for Xiaomi, Redmi, and POCO.
Run this app on a second Android device with an OTG cable. The phone being unlocked stays in fastboot mode.
Unofficial tool. Unlocking may erase all data, void your warranty, and weaken device security. Xiaomi\'s server decides whether your account and device are eligible.
Account authorization from Xiaomi\'s official server is required to unlock the bootloader.
Account connected and ready to use.
Tap the button below to open the official Xiaomi login page in a secure isolated WebView.
You enter your credentials directly on account.xiaomi.com. Your password is never stored or read by this app.
The app captures the temporary STS authorization token and device identifier needed to communicate with Xiaomi\'s unlock API.
Xiaomi\'s servers verify account eligibility, binding time, and unlock permissions before signing the unlock token.
Your credentials are sent directly to Xiaomi over TLS. Only temporary session cookies are retained to sign unlock requests.
Login is processed directly on Xiaomi\'s official servers (account.xiaomi.com) without third-party proxy servers.
The app only extracts the temporary session token for fastboot unlock authorization; your password is never stored.
Session data and cookies can be cleared at any time via the trash icon at the top right.
The account must be bound to the target device in Developer options > Mi Unlock status using mobile data.
Xiaomi\'s servers enforce a waiting period (typically 72 or 168 hours) before unlock authorization is granted.
Connect the target device in Fastboot mode to this host phone using a stable data cable and OTG adapter.
Note: Bootloader Studio is independent software and not affiliated with Xiaomi Inc. Unlock authorization is subject to official Xiaomi server terms.
Xiaomi account session verified. Redirecting to account…
Xiaomi completed the login, but the required session cookies could not be read. Scan the page again, or go back and sign in again.
Your password is entered only on Xiaomi\'s official login page. This app keeps the session in memory and sends the unlock request directly to Xiaomi\'s server.
No Xiaomi session is available. Go back and sign in again.
Your Xiaomi session expired. Sign in again to continue.
Xiaomi\'s server decides whether this account and device are eligible. A waiting period, Community authorization, or quota may still apply.
Power off the Xiaomi phone, hold Volume Down + Power, then connect it to this Android host with an OTG cable.
Device detection is idle. Tap Retry to start again.
This device is already unlocked. No unlock is needed.
Could not communicate with the device.
USB permission was denied. Reconnect the OTG cable or tap Retry to ask again. The app will not keep prompting automatically.
Some devices need a powered OTG hub. Use a good data cable and keep the screen on until the process finishes.
This Android device does not support USB host mode.
Connect the phone in fastboot mode with an OTG cable.
Allow USB access for the connected device.
Still reading the device. Some phones take a few seconds to answer fastboot commands.
The device did not respond in time. Keep the OTG cable connected and tap Refresh or Retry.
The device disconnected during USB communication. Reconnect the OTG cable and tap Refresh.
A different device is connected. Tap Refresh to detect it again before continuing.
The device token changed. Tap Refresh and restart the unlock process from the beginning.
Could not read the device token. Reconnect the phone in fastboot mode and tap Refresh.
Could not re-read the device token. Reconnect the phone in fastboot mode and restart the process.
Could not open the USB device. Reconnect the OTG cable and tap Refresh.
Could not read the device codename. Reconnect the phone in fastboot mode.
USB permission was denied. Reconnect the OTG cable or tap Retry.
Unlocking the bootloader usually erases all user data and may void the warranty. Back up your phone before continuing.
Checking account and device eligibility with Xiaomi…
This device will erase user data when unlocked.
This device does not erase user data when unlocked.
Data wipe behavior was not reported by the server.
I understand the risks and want to request the unlock.
This app sends the same server-authorized request as Xiaomi\'s official Windows tool. It cannot bypass a waiting period, quota, or Community authorization.
Xiaomi did not return unlock data. Start the request again.
The device rejected the unlock data.
The device rejected the unlock command.
The unlock request expired. Requesting a fresh nonce from Xiaomi…
Keep the OTG cable connected until the process finishes.
Xiaomi checks the account, device token, region, waiting period, and quota.
The signed unlock token is written to the device over USB fastboot.
The bootloader applies the token and may erase all data.
Do not unplug the cable, close the app, or power off either device during this process.
If the phone shows an unlock confirmation prompt, use the volume keys to choose Unlock/Yes and press the power button to confirm.
No automatic retry was attempted. Review the error, then go back and start again when the issue is resolved.
Bootloader unlocked and verified. The device now reports its bootloader as unlocked.

The unlock command was accepted. The device rebooted or disconnected before its lock state could be re-read, so verification was not possible. Check the boot screen: an unlocked bootloader usually shows a warning before Android starts.

The device still reports its bootloader as locked. Some models wait for confirmation on the phone: use the volume keys to choose Unlock/Yes and press the power button. After confirming, reconnect in fastboot mode and check the lock state again. Do not repeat the server request until you have checked.
The bootloader accepted Xiaomi\'s unlock token. The device may reboot and erase all user data.
The unlock sequence stopped before completion.
Do not relock the bootloader unless you are on a fully stock, verified ROM. Xiaomi\'s server does not need to be contacted again for this device.
No automatic retry was made. Fix the account, network, or device issue described above, then run the unlock again. Repeated rejected requests can extend the waiting period.
This is an unofficial client. Xiaomi\'s server remains the authority and can require a waiting period, Community authorization, or a quota before it signs the unlock token.
Open Settings > About phone and tap the MIUI or HyperOS version seven times.
Open Settings > Additional settings > Developer options and enable OEM unlocking.
In Developer options, open Mi Unlock status, agree to the notice, and tap Add account and device. Use the same account you will sign in with here.
HyperOS devices may require an eligible Mi Community level and an unlock authorization before the server accepts the request. Follow the current Xiaomi policy shown in the Community app.
Xiaomi may enforce a waiting period, a monthly token limit, and a yearly device limit. This app cannot bypass those checks. Keep the account bound to the device while you wait.
Unlocking usually erases all data and may void the warranty. Back up first and keep the phone above 50% battery.
Power off the Xiaomi phone, hold Volume Down + Power, then connect it to this Android host with an OTG cable. Tap Start Unlock and follow the screens.
No Xiaomi account is signed in.
The session is saved on this device. You can sign out at any time to clear cookies and saved session data.

An unofficial, open client for Xiaomi bootloader unlock. It follows the same server-authorized procedure as Xiaomi\'s official Windows Mi Unlock tool and does not bypass account, region, waiting-period, quota, or Community requirements.
Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Xiaomi. Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO, MIUI, HyperOS, and Mi Unlock are trademarks of Xiaomi Inc.
Unlocking the bootloader can erase all data, void the warranty, and reduce device security. Use this app at your own risk.
Signing logic is based on the Apache-2.0 licensed MiTools reference implementation. Fastboot communication uses Android USB Host APIs. No Xiaomi source code or proprietary binaries are bundled.
The Xiaomi session and login cookies will be removed from this app. You can sign in again at any time.
